title: docs(qa): lift action-location-matrix's no-surface knownGap now that the showcase hosts record_header / record_more / record_related
body:
Fixes #22039
Clause-②: no

The showcase change carded as #22030 landed as PR #22036 (`60ccda5a24`). It hosts `record_header`, `record_more` and `record_related` for `showcase_task` on stock showcase pages. This PR lifts the row-7 fixture knownGap on `records-forms.action-location-matrix` that parked those three locations, and A3's url / api dispatch legs, on that card. It is a checklist-only diff: one item in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`, no other item, no code.

## What changed (item `records-forms.action-location-matrix`, revision 8 to 9)

| Key | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `revision` | 8 | 9 |
| `fixtures.knownGaps[1]` | "the showcase hosts NO surface for three of the six locations on showcase_task …"; score them blocked(fixture); park on #22030 | Opens with a closed marker citing #22030 / PR #22036 / `60ccda5a24` and this card, then says where each location now lives on a stock boot (below) |
| `steps[1]` | surfaces listed as "a not-done task's detail title bar / its ⋯ menu / a related-list section", plus "A location with no hosting surface at this fixture (record_header / record_more / record_related) is recorded blocked(fixture)" | Names each host: the Task Detail title bar, that title bar's ⋯ menu, and the rows of the Tasks related list on Project Detail's Related tab, "not the Tasks tab's line-items grid". The blocked(fixture) sentence is gone |
| `acceptance[0].clause` | "… a parent record page that renders the synthesized Tasks related list …" | "… renders the Tasks related list …" (one word dropped) |
| `acceptance[0].verify` | "At this fixture record_header, record_more and record_related are not hosted: record those three blocked(fixture), never as missing placements" | "The stock fixture hosts all six (fixtures.knownGaps names the page and tab …): an expected action absent from its host is a missing placement, never blocked(fixture)" |
| `acceptance[2].clause` | "The url (open_docs) and api (recalc_selection) legs live on record_more and share its fixture gap: record them blocked(fixture) with it, never as dispatch failures" | "The url (open_docs) and api (recalc_selection) legs live on record_more, under the ⋯ overflow of the Task Detail title bar" |
| `history` | 8 entries | plus one: revision 9, 2026-10-06, ref `#22039`, citing #22030 / PR #22036 |

`fixtures.knownGaps[0]` (the objectui-pinned automation) is byte-identical. No other key and no other item changed. A structural diff of all 43 items against `60ccda5a24` shows exactly one changed item.

### The rewritten knownGap: where each location lives

- **`record_header` / `record_more`: Task Detail** (`showcase_task_detail`, the record page the console opens for any task). Its first node is a `page:header`. The header renders the action ids it lists, each placed by its own `locations`, and the host's Edit / Share / Delete come after them.
  - Inline on a desktop viewport: `showcase_mark_done` (script, shown only while the task is not done), `showcase_log_time` (form) and `showcase_archive_task` (script, disabled until done).
  - Under the ⋯ overflow: `showcase_open_docs` (url), `showcase_recalc_estimate` (api) and `showcase_recalc_selection` (api).
  - The default inline budget is 3 (1 on mobile), and a `record_header` action past it folds into ⋯. Read from the `page:header` renderer at the objectui pin `a58626c88dc8`. The knownGap names this so that a runner on a narrow viewport does not score a folded action as an extra `record_more` placement.
- **`record_related`: Project Detail** (`showcase_project_detail`), on the **Related tab** (`?tab=related`). The tab holds the Tasks related list, a `record:related_list` for `showcase_task` through its `project` FK. As PR #22036 noted, this is an authored node, not the synthesizer's strip. The page's `tabs` override still replaces that strip, and the tab puts the list back with no `actions` key, so its rows carry `showcase_log_time` beside the task's `list_item` actions. The Tasks tab next to it is the `record:line_items` grid, which hosts no `record_related` action.
- A missing action on any of these hosts is now a missing placement, not blocked(fixture). The knownGap says the hosts were read from objectui source and served metadata, not from a browser render, because PR #22036 left the browser render NOT MEASURED. The first run against these hosts will be their first browser evidence.

### Scope reading, declared

The dispatch scopes edits to `fixtures.requires`, `steps` and acceptance `verify` lines that still send the runner to a surface that does not host the leg. Two of the lines above are acceptance `clause` texts, not `verify` lines. Revision 7 added the gap's blocked(fixture) instructions in five places: knownGaps[1], step 2, clause 1, clause 1's verify, and clause 3. The item diff between `ff29410ed2` and `18c7dfd2e6` shows them. Clause 3's last sentence parks the url / api legs by itself, so leaving it would keep A3 parked after the lift. Clause 1's "synthesized" sends a runner to look for a strip that the page's `tabs` override removes. The edit to each clause is the minimum that undoes revision 7's gap text. Nothing else in either clause changed. `fixtures.requires` is unchanged: it describes the fleet and does not point the runner at any surface.

## Verification (head `d99f1f57ee`, after the final commit)

- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the actual diff derived 13 commands. The list is the same at both commits. Each was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe, and all 13 exited 0. `--ran`: "13 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 13 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
  - `check:platform-checklist`: "OK — 15 areas, 276 items (272 active, 2 planned) …".
  - `check:doc-authoring`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:nul-bytes` are green.
  - On the first commit, `check:doc-formula-expressions` answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` were unbuilt). Both were then built under `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0), and the gate ran green at both commits.
- **The two checklist-reading package tests** run on the final head. These are the only tests declared as reading these files: `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` names `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` for plugin-auth and `docs/**` for rest, and nothing else.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/checklist-refusal-envelope-consistency.test.ts`: exit 0, 1 file / 5 tests passed.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/meta-state-route-doc-spelling.test.ts`: exit 0, 1 file / 8 tests passed.
- **Lint:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the changed file returns 1 file and 0 errors. The one message is "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied". No block in `eslint.config.mjs` covers `.json` under `docs/`, so this diff cannot move any lint verdict. The full `pnpm lint` run is CI's.
- **Changeset:** 69 published workspace manifests. None has a `files[]` entry naming `docs/qa` or the checklist (0 hits). Positive control: all 69 name `dist` (69 hits). The path is outside every package directory, so this diff publishes nothing. Hence `skip-changeset`.
- **Typecheck / package tests:** no package source changed, so neither is owed locally. CI's Test Core reruns plugin-auth and rest because their declared inputs moved.

## Acceptance notes

- **The empty-locations probe cannot discriminate on two authored-list surfaces.** The Task Detail `page:header` renders only the ids it lists (objectui `containers.tsx`, `resolvedHeaderActions`). The `record:quick_actions` bar is also an explicit `actionNames` list. So the step-7 probe action, and `showcase_new_task`, are absent from the record header, the ⋯ overflow and the quick-actions bar because those lists leave them out. That absence is decided before any `locations` predicate runs. The probe's verdict therefore rests on the list toolbar, the row menu and the related-list rows. The quick-actions half predates this card. The header half is new, because before PR #22036 the header did not exist. Not filed: this is an item-design observation, not a runtime defect, a contract violation or an authoring trap. Carrier: none.
- `fixtures.requires[0]` and clause 4 spell mark_done's predicate as `'!record.done'`. The fixture's actual predicate is `has(record.done) && record.done != true`. `requires[0]` also leaves out `showcase_recalc_estimate` and `showcase_archive_task`, which the header now carries. Neither points the runner at a wrong surface, so both are outside this card's edit rule and are left as they are. Carrier: none.
- NOT MEASURED: the browser render of the new hosts, as in PR #22036. No console bundle is built in this checkout. The knownGap says so.

## Labels

`skip-changeset`: checklist-only diff, measured above.
